episodes.title: Casino Bar
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik's life shifts when his old friend suggests they start a gambling business.

episodes.title: Tax Bomb
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik flees to the Philippines, and squanders all his money in a casino.

episodes.title: The Ten-Year Debt
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik joins Min Seokjun in the casino business.

episodes.title: Rolling
episodes.summary: Moosik gains full authority over the casino and earns sixty billion won over ten years.

episodes.title: The Game Plan
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik is introduced to a new financier, Jung Sukwoo.

episodes.title: Korean Desk
episodes.summary: Oh Seunghoon of the Korean Desk is dispatched to the Philippines, and meets his partner, Mark.

episodes.title: The Sugarcane Field Murder
episodes.summary: Two Koreans are found murdered in a sugar cane field.

episodes.title: The Kidnapping
episodes.summary: Upon hearing Jungpal's request, Cha Moosik kidnaps Deokbae.

episodes.title: Mortal Enemies
episodes.summary: Seo Taeseok attempts to shoot Moosik. He leaves the Philippines.

episodes.title: Assassins
episodes.summary: Youngdo gang members enter the Philippines to take care of Cha Moosik.

episodes.title: Mayfly
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik settles Jungpal's debts with the Triad, and brings Jungpal back to the Philippines.

episodes.title: Framed
episodes.summary: Min Seokjun is dead and Moosik is arrested as the suspect of the murder.

episodes.title: The Last Ruling
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik is extradited to Korea as a murder suspect, and goes to trial.

episodes.title: Comeback
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik returns to the Philippines and heads to the casino, only to find that a lot has changed.

episodes.title: To be or not to be
episodes.summary: Cha Moosik's revenge begins, as he is ready to spill blood.

episodes.title: Forced Repatriation
episodes.summary: Moosik goes into hiding. Jungpal, Sang-gu, John, and Seunghoon all head to Moosik's hideout.
